nodes.name: Electrolyte Preparation and pH Adjustment
nodes.procedure: NaClO4 solutions with concentrations of 0.5, 1, 5 and 10 m were prepared by mixing an appropriate amount of salt with H2O or D2O. A small amount of concentrated HClO4 or DCl was added to the electrolyte to obtain the potential response for pH/pD titration.

nodes.name: SHINERS Electrode Preparation
nodes.procedure: A 5-mm Cu disk was polished with 50-nm alumina, electropolished with concentrated phosphoric acid at 1.6 V for 20 min, rinsed, and dried. Then, 2 µl of Au@SiO2 solution was drop-cast onto the surface and dried under Ar.

unit_operations.name: Drop casting
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: 2 µl drop of Au@SiO2 solution was drop cast onto the electropolished Cu surface and dried under a gentle stream of Ar

nodes.description: Steady-state CO electroreduction in varying NaClO4 concentrations
nodes.source_text: Increasing the NaClO4 concentration from 0.01 to 10 molal increased the CO reduction rate 18-fold, achieving a Faradaic efficiency of 91% for multi-carbon products at −1.43 V versus the normal hydrogen electrode. ...total current density (j) monotonically rose from -3 to -54 mA/cm2.

nodes.description: Temperature-dependent CO reduction kinetics and Arrhenius analysis
nodes.source_text: Across the entire ionic strength range probed in this study, the Tafel slopes remained 123.4 ± 2.9 mV dec−1... for NaClO4 concentrations above 1 m, both Ea and log(A) systematically increased with rising salt concentration.

nodes.description: In situ SHINERS of interfacial water structure
nodes.source_text: The difference spectra clearly show that interfacial hydrogen bonding is systematically diminished with increasing NaClO4 concentration... free OH can be detected at potentials as low as −0.85 V in 10 m NaClO4.

nodes.characterization_summary: Bulk Raman of NaClO4 electrolytes shows decreased hydrogen bonding (3,243 and 3,413 cm-1) and increased water coordination to Na+ (3,570 cm-1) as concentration increases.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Bulk Raman spectroscopy of the OH stretching vibration ... bands associated with the symmetric (3,243 cm−1) and asymmetric (3,413 cm−1) vibrational modes ... decreased monotonically as the concentration of NaClO4 was increased

properties.observation: Intensity increases as potential becomes more negative

nodes.characterization_summary: Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) measured double-layer capacitance (DLC) to evaluate cation coverage and surface area stability. It confirmed that surface area post-electrolysis did not depend on NaClO4 concentration.
nodes.evidence_snippet: we evaluated the surface structure and area of the electrode before electrolysis by... electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS)... surface area and structure post-electrolysis did not display a dependence on NaClO4 concentration

nodes.characterization_summary: OH adsorption via cyclic voltammetry was used to evaluate surface structure, showing that high ionic strength does not influence the catalyst surface structure.
nodes.evidence_snippet: we evaluated the surface structure and area of the electrode before electrolysis by OH adsorption via cyclic voltammetry (CV) ... the surface area and structure post-electrolysis did not display a dependence on NaClO4 concentration

nodes.characterization_summary: Real-time gaseous product detection (H2, CH4, C2H4) provided Tafel slopes of ~123.4 mV/dec, suggesting a rate-determining step of reductive CO-CO coupling.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Across the entire ionic strength range probed in this study, the Tafel slopes remained 123.4 ± 2.9 mV dec−1 ... involving the reductive coupling of two molecules of CO

nodes.characterization_summary: In situ SHINERS reveals systematic suppression of hydrogen-bonded water (3,300-3,400 cm-1) and emergence of non-hydrogen-bonded 'free OH' modes (3,550-3,700 cm-1) at high salt concentrations.
nodes.evidence_snippet: difference spectra clearly show that interfacial hydrogen bonding is systematically diminished with increasing NaClO4 concentration ... emergence of non-hydrogen-bonded water modes, suggesting that disordered interfacial H2O layers facilitate CO reduction

nodes.characterization_summary: 1H NMR spectroscopy was used to identify and quantify liquid products like EtOH, acetate, and n-PrOH using water suppression and DMSO internal standard.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Liquid products were analysed by NMR spectroscopy (Bruker 400 MHz) using DMSO... One-dimensional 1 H NMR spectra were measured via water suppression ... all peak positions were shifted relative to the standard peak of DMSO

nodes.evidence_snippet: Gaseous reaction products were analysed using a Shimadzu GCMS-QP2020 SE... Gaseous products were collected every 10 min by directly venting the gas from the gas flow field
